title: tls: cert expiry estimated from file mtime, not X.509 notAfter field
description: In tls.rs, load_or_generate_cert() estimates certificate expiry as cert_path mtime + 365 days rather than reading the X.509 notAfter field directly. If mtime changes (backup restore, touch, filesystem migration) the expiry warning fires at the wrong time or is silenced entirely. The self-signed cert generated by rcgen has a notAfter that is always exactly 365 days from issue, but the mtime of the file on disk is not a reliable proxy for when the cert was issued. Fix: parse the PEM/DER certificate with a small X.509 parser (e.g. the x509-parser crate, or rustls's built-in cert structure) and read NotAfter directly. This removes the mtime dependency and gives accurate expiry warnings regardless of file timestamps.
